title: Climate Change and Monetary Policy: Issues for Policy Design and Modelling
abstract: This paper explores the interaction of monetary policy and climate change as they jointly influence macroeconomic outcomes, connecting policy and outcomes in each realm to the implications of the other. It also explores the nature of the macroeconomic model that would be required to explore the links between monetary policy and climate policy. The paper has four parts. First, it reviews the relevant macroeconomic outcomes of emissions mitigation policy and climatic disruption, exploring how negative supply shocks can affect central banks’ ability to forecast and manage inflation. Second, the paper reviews basic approaches to monetary policy, including inflation and output targeting, and other responsibilities that may fall to central bankers. Third, we bring together the two sets of issues to consider the appropriate monetary framework in a carbon-constrained and climatically disrupted world and to highlight the climate policy frameworks that can make monetary policies more efficient and effective. We then summarize the nature of the macroeconomic modelling framework that is needed to better analyse climate and monetary policy interactions. We conclude that policy responses to climate change can have important implications for monetary policy and vice versa and that, in light of the urgency of ambitious climate action, these policy spheres should be brought together more explicitly and more appropriate macroeconomic modelling frameworks developed.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了货币政策与气候变化的相互作用，二者共同影响宏观经济结果，并将每一领域的政策与结果同另一领域的影响联系起来。本文还探讨了为研究货币政策与气候政策之间的联系所需的宏观经济模型的性质。全文分为四个部分。第一，本文回顾了减排政策与气候扰动的相关宏观经济结果，探讨负向供给冲击如何影响中央银行预测和管理通胀的能力。第二，本文回顾了货币政策的基本方法，包括通胀目标制与产出目标制，以及中央银行人员可能承担的其他职责。第三，我们将这两组问题结合起来，考虑在碳约束和气候扰动的世界中适当的货币框架，并强调哪些气候政策框架可以使货币政策更加高效和有效。随后，我们总结了更好地分析气候政策与货币政策相互作用所需的宏观经济建模框架的性质。我们的结论是，应对气候变化的政策可能对货币政策产生重要影响，反之亦然；鉴于开展雄心勃勃的气候行动的紧迫性，这些政策领域应当更加明确地结合起来，并发展更为恰当的宏观经济建模框架。

title: Global Economic and Environmental Outcomes of the Paris Agreement
Overview of the EMF 32 Study on U.S. Carbon Tax Scenarios
abstract: The Energy Modeling Forum (EMF) 32 study on carbon tax scenarios analyzed a set of illustrative policies in the United States that place an economy-wide tax on fossil-fuel-related carbon dioxide (CO[Formula: see text] emissions, a carbon tax for short. Eleven modeling teams ran these stylized scenarios, which vary by the initial carbon tax rate, the rate at which the tax escalates over time, and the use of the revenues. Modelers reported their results for the effects of the policies, relative to a reference scenario that does not include a carbon tax, on emissions, economic activity, and outcomes within the U.S. energy system. This paper explains the scenario design, presents an overview of the results, and compares results from the participating models. In particular, we compare various outcomes across the models, such as emissions, revenue, gross domestic product, sectoral impacts, and welfare.
abstract_zh: 能源建模论坛（Energy Modeling Forum, EMF）第32项研究针对碳税情景展开，分析了美国的一组示例性政策，这些政策对化石燃料相关的二氧化碳（CO2）排放征收覆盖整个经济体的税收，简称碳税。11个建模团队运行了这些情景化的设定，其差异体现在初始碳税税率、税率随时间上升的速度以及税收收入的使用方式上。相对于不包含碳税的参照情景，建模者报告了政策对排放、经济活动以及美国能源系统内部结果的影响。本文说明了情景设计，概述了结果，并对各参与模型的结果进行了比较。特别地，我们比较了各模型之间的多种结果，如排放量、税收收入、国内生产总值（GDP）、部门影响以及福利。

title: The Role of Border Carbon Adjustments in a U.S. Carbon Tax
abstract:
This paper examines carbon tax design options in the United States using an intertemporal computable general equilibrium model of the world economy called G-Cubed. In this paper, we discuss four policy scenarios that explore two overarching issues: (1) the effects of a carbon tax under alternative assumptions about the use of the resulting revenue, and (2) the effects of a system of import charges on carbon-intensive goods (“border carbon adjustments” or BCAs).
Consistent with earlier studies, we find that the carbon tax raises considerable revenue and reduces CO2 emissions significantly relative to baseline, no matter how the revenue is used. Gross annual revenue from the carbon tax with lump sum rebating and no BCA begins at $110 billion in 2020 and rises gradually to $170 billion in 2040. By 2040, annual CO2 emissions fall from 5.5 billion metric tons (BMT) under the baseline to 2.4 BMT, a decline of 3.1 BMT, or 57%. Cumulative emissions over 2020 to 2040 fall by 48 BMT.
Also consistent with earlier studies, we find that the carbon tax has very small overall impacts on gross domestic product (GDP), wages, employment, and consumption. Different uses of the revenue from the carbon tax result in slightly different levels and compositions of GDP across consumption, investment and net exports. Overall, using carbon tax revenue to reduce the capital income tax rate results in better macroeconomic outcomes than using the revenue for lump sum transfers.
Counter to their purported purpose of protecting U.S. trade strength, for a given revenue policy, BCAs tend to produce lower net exports than the carbon taxes alone. This is generally because the BCAs raise the value of the dollar relative to other currencies, thus lowering exports more than they lower imports. This is consistent with standard results in the international trade literature on the effects of import tariffs and export subsidies on real exchange rates, a result that is often overlooked in the discussion of domestic carbon policy.
In a finding new to the literature, our results show that BCAs can have strikingly different effects depending on the use of the revenue. Under a lump sum rebate, BCAs exacerbate the impact of the carbon tax by lowering domestic output further than it would fall under the carbon tax alone. Under a capital tax swap, however, BCAs have a moderating effect: they reduce the impact of the tax on most industries.
abstract_zh:
本文利用名为G-Cubed的世界经济跨期可计算一般均衡模型，考察了美国碳税的设计选项。本文讨论了四种政策情景，探讨两个总体性问题：（1）在关于税收收入使用的不同假设下，碳税的效应；（2）对碳密集型商品征收进口费用的制度（即“边境碳调整”或BCA）的效应。
与早期研究一致，我们发现，无论收入如何使用，碳税都能征得可观的收入，并相对于基准情形显著减少CO2排放。在采用一次性总额返还且不实行BCA的情况下，碳税的年度毛收入在2020年为1100亿美元，并逐步增至2040年的1700亿美元。到2040年，年度CO2排放量由基准情形下的55亿公吨（BMT）降至24亿公吨，减少31亿公吨，即57%。2020至2040年间的累计排放量减少48亿公吨。
同样与早期研究一致，我们发现，碳税对国内生产总值（GDP）、工资、就业和消费的总体影响非常小。税收收入的不同用途会导致GDP在消费、投资和净出口之间产生略有差异的水平与构成。总体而言，将碳税收入用于降低资本所得税税率，比用于一次性总额转移支付能带来更好的宏观经济结果。
与其保护美国贸易实力的宣称目的相反，在给定收入政策的情况下，BCA往往使净出口低于仅实施碳税时的水平。这通常是因为BCA抬高了美元相对于其他货币的价值，从而使出口下降的幅度大于进口下降的幅度。这与国际贸易文献中关于进口关税与出口补贴对实际汇率影响的标准结论相一致，而这一结果在关于国内碳政策的讨论中常被忽视。
我们的结果还显示了一个文献中的新发现：根据收入用途的不同，BCA可能产生截然不同的效应。在一次性总额返还的情况下，BCA会加剧碳税的冲击，使国内产出的下降幅度超过仅实施碳税时的情形。而在以资本税替代的方式下，BCA则起到缓和作用：它们减轻了税收对大多数行业的冲击。

title: The Welfare Consequences of Taxing Carbon
abstract:
For EMF 32, we applied a new version of our Intertemporal General Equilibrium Model (IGEM) based on the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS). We simulated the impacts arising from the Energy Modeling Forum’s broad range of carbon taxes under three revenue recycling options — lump sum redistributions, capital tax reductions, and labor tax cuts. We examined their consequences for industry prices and quantities, for the overall economy, and for the welfare of households, individuals, and society, the latter in terms of efficiency and equity. We rank recycling mechanisms from most to least favorable in terms of the magnitudes of their impacts on net social welfare — efficiency net of equity — recognizing that other objectives may be more important to policy makers and the public. Finally, we and the EMF 32 effort focus only on the economic effects of carbon taxation and revenue recycling; the environmental benefits arising from emissions reductions are not within our scope of study.
We find CO2 emissions abatement to be invariant to the chosen recycling scheme. This means that policy makers need not compromise their environmental objectives when designing carbon tax swap options. We also find additional emissions reductions beyond the scope of coverage and points of taxation.
Reducing capital taxes promotes new saving, investment and capital formation and is the most favorable recycling mechanism. In 2010 dollars, the welfare loss per ton abated ranges from $0.19 to $3.90 depending on the path of carbon prices. Reducing labor taxes promotes consumption and work through real-wage incentives and is the next most favorable recycling scheme. Here, the welfare loss per ton abated ranges from $11.09 to $16.49 depending on the carbon tax trajectory. Lump sum redistribution of carbon tax revenues is the least favorable recycling option. It incentivizes neither capital nor labor. Consequently, the damages to the economy and welfare are the greatest among the three schemes. With lump sum recycling, the welfare loss per ton abated ranges from $37.15 to $43.61 as carbon taxation becomes more aggressive. While this ranking is common among the participating EMF 32 models, the spread in our results is the greatest in comparison which we attribute to the substitution possibilities inherent in IGEM’s econometrics, the absence of barriers to factor mobility, and likely differences in the manner in which tax incentives are structured.
We find welfare gains are possible under capital and labor tax recycling when emissions accounting is viewed from a top-down rather than a bottom-up perspective and carbon pricing is at an economy-wide average. However, these gains occur at the expense of abatement.
We find capital tax recycling to be regressive while labor tax recycling is progressive as is redistribution through lump sums. Moreover, we find that the lump sum mechanism provides the best means for sheltering the poorest from the welfare consequences of carbon taxation. Thus, promoting capital formation is the best use of carbon tax revenues in terms of reducing the magnitudes of welfare losses while the lump sum and labor tax options are the best uses for reducing inequality.
abstract_zh:
针对EMF 32，我们应用了基于北美产业分类体系（NAICS）的跨期一般均衡模型（IGEM）新版本。我们模拟了能源建模论坛所设定的多种碳税在三种收入回收方式下的影响：一次性总额再分配、降低资本税以及降低劳动税。我们考察了这些政策对行业价格与产量、整体经济以及家庭、个人和社会福利（从效率与公平两方面衡量）的影响。我们依据净社会福利（即扣除公平影响后的效率）的影响大小，对收入回收机制从最有利到最不利进行了排序，同时认识到其他目标对政策制定者和公众而言可能更为重要。最后，我们与EMF 32项目一样，仅关注碳税与收入回收的经济效应；减排所带来的环境效益不在我们的研究范围之内。
我们发现，CO2减排量不受所选回收方案的影响。这意味着，政策制定者在设计碳税互换方案时无需在环境目标上做出妥协。我们还发现，存在超出覆盖范围和征税点的额外减排。
降低资本税可促进新增储蓄、投资与资本形成，是最有利的回收机制。以2010年美元计，每吨减排的福利损失取决于碳价路径，范围为0.19至3.90美元。降低劳动税通过实际工资激励促进消费与工作，是次优的回收方案。在这种情况下，每吨减排的福利损失取决于碳税轨迹，范围为11.09至16.49美元。一次性总额再分配是最不利的收入回收选项，因为它既不激励资本，也不激励劳动。因此，在三种方案中，它对经济和福利造成的损害最大。在一次性总额回收下，随着碳税力度加大，每吨减排的福利损失范围为37.15至43.61美元。尽管这一排序在参与EMF 32的各模型中具有普遍性，但我们的结果之间的差异最大，我们将其归因于IGEM计量经济学中固有的替代可能性、要素流动性不存在障碍，以及税收激励结构可能存在的差异。
当从自上而下而非自下而上的视角核算排放，且碳定价处于全经济平均水平时，我们发现，无论是资本税还是劳动税的收入回收均可能带来福利增益。然而，这些增益是以牺牲减排为代价的。
我们发现，资本税回收具有累退性，而劳动税回收具有累进性，一次性总额再分配同样具有累进性。此外，我们发现，一次性总额机制为最贫困人口抵御碳税的福利后果提供了最佳保护。因此，就减少福利损失的幅度而言，促进资本形成是碳税收入的最佳用途；而就减少不平等而言，一次性总额与劳动税选项则是最佳用途。

title: Carbon Taxes and Fiscal Reform in the United States
abstract: In this paper we consider the economic and environmental impacts of taxes on emissions of greenhouse gases. Substituting carbon taxes for other sources of revenue or using the proceeds to reduce deficits or finance expenditures are the keys to integration of carbon taxes with fiscal reform. Recycling carbon tax revenues through reductions of capital income tax rates provides the largest margin of economic benefits over the costs of emissions control. Reducing capital tax rates lowers the cost of capital services and increases the rate of capital formation. This mechanism provides a dramatic illustration of the power of intertemporal general equilibrium modeling in the design of new energy and environmental policies for the United States.
abstract_zh: 本文考虑了温室气体排放税的经济与环境影响。以碳税替代其他收入来源，或将税收收入用于削减赤字或为支出提供资金，是碳税与财政改革相融合的关键。将碳税收入通过降低资本所得税税率的方式回收，所带来的经济效益超出减排成本的幅度最大。降低资本税率会降低资本服务的成本，并提高资本形成的速度。这一机制生动地说明了跨期一般均衡建模在设计美国新能源与环境政策中的力量。

title: Controlling Carbon Emissions from U.S. Power Plants: How a Tradable Performance Standard Compares to a Carbon Tax
venue: Brookings Climate and Energy Economics Discussion Paper
abstract: Different pollution control policies, even if they achieve the same emissions goal, could have importantly different effects on the composition of the energy sector and economic outcomes. In this paper, we use the G-Cubed model of the global economy to compare two basic policy approaches for controlling carbon emissions from power plants: a tradable performance standard and a carbon tax. We choose these two approaches because they resemble two key options facing policymakers: continue implementing a performance standard approach under the Clean Air Act or adopt an excise tax on the carbon content of fossil fuels instead. Our goal is to highlight the important high-level differences in these basic approaches, abstracting from the details of specific policy proposals. We explore a wide variety of the illustrative policies’ economic outcomes including: changes in capital stocks and electricity production across eight types of generators, changes in end-user electricity prices, changes in gross domestic product (GDP), overall welfare impacts on the household sector and, finally, one outcome represented in the G-Cubed model and few others: short to medium-run changes in aggregate employment.
abstract_zh: 即使不同的污染控制政策实现了相同的排放目标，它们对能源部门构成和经济结果的影响也可能存在重大差异。本文利用全球经济的G-Cubed模型，比较了控制发电厂碳排放的两种基本政策方式：可交易的绩效标准与碳税。我们选择这两种方式，是因为它们类似于政策制定者面临的两个关键选项：在《清洁空气法》框架下继续实施绩效标准方式，或者转而对化石燃料的含碳量征收消费税。我们的目标是突出这两种基本方式之间重要的高层次差异，而不涉及具体政策提案的细节。我们探讨了这些示例性政策的多种经济结果，包括：八类发电机组的资本存量与发电量变化、终端用户电价变化、国内生产总值（GDP）变化、对家庭部门的总体福利影响，以及G-Cubed模型所刻画的一项结果及其他少数结果——即短期至中期的总就业变化。

title: Pricing Carbon in the U.S.: A Model-Based Analysis of Power-Sector-Only Approaches
The Economic Consequences of Delay in U.S. Climate Policy
venue: Brookings Climate and Energy Economics Discussion Paper
abstract:
The United States Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has begun regulating existing stationary sources of greenhouse gases (GHG) using its authority under the Clean Air Act (the Act). The regulatory process under the Act is long and involved and raises the prospect that significant U.S. action might be delayed for years. This paper examines the economic implications of such a delay.
We analyze four policy scenarios using an economic model of the U.S. economy embedded within a broader model of the world economy. The first scenario imposes an economy-wide carbon tax that starts immediately at $15 and rises annually at 4 percent over inflation. The second two scenarios impose different (and generally higher) carbon tax trajectories that achieve the same cumulative emissions reduction as the first scenario over a period of 24 years, but that start after an eight year delay. All three of these policies use the carbon tax revenue to reduce the federal budget deficit. The fourth policy imposes the same carbon tax as the first scenario but uses the revenue to reduce the tax rate on capital income.
We find that by nearly every measure, the delayed policies produce worse economic outcomes than the more modest policy implemented now, while achieving no better environmental benefits.
abstract_zh:
美国环境保护署（EPA）已开始依据《清洁空气法》（以下简称《法案》）的授权，对现有固定排放源的温室气体（GHG）进行监管。《法案》下的监管程序冗长复杂，可能导致美国的重大行动推迟数年。本文考察了这种推迟的经济含义。
我们利用嵌入于更广泛的世界经济模型中的美国经济模型，分析了四种政策情景。第一种情景是实施一项覆盖整个经济体的碳税，从立即开始，以每年4%（扣除通胀）的速度递增，初始税率为每吨15美元。后两种情景实施了不同的（且通常更高的）碳税路径，这些路径在24年内实现与第一种情景相同的累计减排量，但都在八年的延迟之后开始。这三项政策均将碳税收入用于减少联邦预算赤字。第四项政策征收与第一种情景相同的碳税，但将收入用于降低资本所得税税率。
我们发现，几乎在所有指标上，延迟实施的政策所产生的经济结果都比现在实施的较为温和的政策更差，而其环境效益却并不更好。

title: Bridging the Gap: Integrating Price Mechanisms into International Climate Negotiations
venue: Brookings Climate and Energy Economics Discussion Paper
abstract:
The Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) continue their efforts to forge a new binding international agreement by 2015. The negotiations face daunting odds, but the 2009 Copenhagen Accord’s shift towards heterogeneous national commitments was a positive step forward for climate policy. The prior presumption that binding commitments could only take the form of a percentage reduction relative to historical levels alienated rapidly industrializing countries and led to unproductive disputes over base years and other issues of target formulation. However, the disparate approaches now under discussion complicate comparing the likely emissions reductions and economic efforts required to achieve the commitments. This paper makes two points. First, we offer good reasons and ways to adapt international negotiations to allow for price-based commitments. The economic uncertainty surrounding target-only commitments is enormous. Combining a clear cumulative emissions target with limits on the cost associated with achieving the target would balance the environmental objective with the need to ensure that commitments remain feasible. This economic insurance could foster greater participation in the agreement and more ambitious commitments. Specifically, we suggest that in addition to their cumulative emissions targets for the 2013 to 2020 period, major economies could agree to a “price collar” on greenhouse gas emissions in their domestic economies. This would include starting floor and ceiling prices on a ton of CO2 and a schedule for real increases in those prices. All major parties would need to show at least a minimum level of effort regardless of whether they achieve their emissions target, and they would be allowed to exceed their target if they are unable to achieve it in spite of undertaking a high level of effort. The paper provides an example of how a price collar would work in the US context under a cap-and-trade system.
Second, analyzing proposed climate commitments in terms of their implied economic stringency, as measured by the implied price on carbon necessary to achieve the targets, offers transparent and verifiable assurance of the comparability of effort across countries. It possible to calculate “carbon price equivalents” of climate commitments in a conceptually similar way to the tariff equivalents used in international trade negotiations.
In sum, the lack of transparency in the level of effort involved in achieving particular emissions targets highlights the potential value of allowing for price-based commitments and argues for greater economic transparency in the international negotiation process.
abstract_zh:
《联合国气候变化框架公约》（UNFCCC）缔约方仍在努力，力争在2015年前达成一项新的具有约束力的国际协定。谈判面临严峻的困难，但2009年《哥本哈根协议》推动的异质性国家承诺转向，是气候政策向前迈出的积极一步。此前的预设是，具有约束力的承诺只能采取相对于历史水平的减排百分比形式，这疏远了快速工业化的国家，并在基准年和其他目标设定问题上引发了徒劳的争执。然而，目前讨论的各种不同方法使得比较各国可能实现的减排量及实现承诺所需的经济努力变得更加复杂。本文提出两点。第一，我们有充分的理由，也有相应的方法，来调整国际谈判，使其允许基于价格的承诺。仅以目标为依据的承诺所面临的经济不确定性是巨大的。将明确的累计排放目标与实现该目标的成本上限相结合，可以在环境目标与确保承诺仍然可行的需要之间取得平衡。这种经济保险有助于促进更广泛的参与和更雄心勃勃的承诺。具体而言，我们建议，除了在2013至2020年期间设定累计排放目标外，主要经济体还可以同意对其国内经济中的温室气体排放实施“价格区间”（price collar）。这将包括设定每吨CO2的起始价格下限与上限，以及这些价格实际上升的时间表。所有主要缔约方都需要付出至少最低限度的努力，无论其是否实现排放目标；如果其尽了高水平的努力但仍无法实现目标，则允许其超出目标。本文以美国在总量控制与交易体系下的情形为例，说明了价格区间的运作方式。
第二，依据隐含的经济严格程度（以实现目标所需的隐含碳价衡量）来分析拟议的气候承诺，能够为各国努力的可比性提供透明且可核查的保证。可以用一种在概念上与国际贸易谈判中所用关税等价物相似的方式，计算气候承诺的“碳价等价物”。
总之，实现特定排放目标所涉努力程度缺乏透明度，凸显了允许基于价格的承诺的潜在价值，也主张在国际谈判过程中提高经济透明度。

title: Comparing Climate Commitments: A Model-Based Analysis of the Copenhagen Accord
abstract: The political accord struck by world leaders at the United Nations negotiations in Copenhagen in December 2009 allows participating countries to express their greenhouse gas commitments in a variety of ways. For example, developed countries promised different percent emissions reductions relative to different base years by 2020. China and India committed to reducing their emissions per unit of gross domestic product (GDP) relative to 2005 by 40 and 20 percent respectively. Such flexibility promotes consensus by allowing each country to use its preferred commitment formulation. However, the disparate approaches and widely varying baseline trends across different economies complicate comparing the likely emissions reductions and economic efforts required to achieve the commitments.
abstract_zh: 2009年12月，世界各国领导人在哥本哈根举行的联合国谈判中达成政治协议，允许参与国以多种方式表述其温室气体承诺。例如，发达国家承诺到2020年相对于不同基准年实现不同的排放削减百分比。中国和印度则分别承诺，相对于2005年，将单位国内生产总值（GDP）的排放量降低40%和20%。这种灵活性通过允许每个国家采用其偏好的承诺表述而促进了共识。然而，各经济体各不相同的做法以及差异很大的基准趋势，使得比较各国可能实现的减排量以及实现承诺所需的经济努力变得复杂。

title: Subsidizing Household Capital: How Does Energy Efficiency Policy Compare to a Carbon Tax?
abstract: This study uses a general equilibrium model to compare environmental and economic outcomes of two policies: (1) a tax credit of 10 percent of the price of household capital that is 20 percent more energy efficient than its unsubsidized counterpart, assuming half of new household investment qualifies for the credit; and (2) a tax starting at $30 ($2007) per metric ton of CO2 rising five percent annually. By 2040, the carbon tax and tax credit reduce emissions by about 60 1.5 percent, respectively. Assuming other countries impose no carbon price, we find that although the carbon tax reduces U.S. GDP, it improves U.S. household welfare because it reduces world fuel prices, strengthens U.S. terms of trade, and makes imports cheaper. The revenue neutral tax credit reduces welfare but boosts U.S. GDP growth slightly at first. Both policies have similar impacts on the federal budget, but of opposite signs. doi: 10.5547/ISSN0195-6574-EJ-Vol32-SI1-7
abstract_zh: 本研究利用一般均衡模型，比较了两种政策的环境与经济结果：（1）对能效比未获补贴同类产品高20%的家庭资本，给予其价格10%的税收抵免，并假设新增家庭投资中有一半符合抵免条件；（2）以每吨CO230美元（2007年美元）起征、并以每年5%的速度递增的碳税。到2040年，碳税与税收抵免分别使排放量减少约60%和1.5%。假设其他国家不实施任何碳价，我们发现，尽管碳税降低了美国GDP，但它改善了美国家庭福利，因为它降低了世界燃料价格，改善了美国的贸易条件，并使进口更便宜。收入中性的税收抵免降低了福利，但在初期对美国GDP增长略有促进作用。两种政策对联邦预算的影响相似，但符号相反。doi: 10.5547/ISSN0195-6574-EJ-Vol32-SI1-7

title: The Distributional Impact of Climate Policy
venue: B.E. Journal of Economic Analysis and Policy
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present a new methodology for evaluating the distributional impacts of climate policy. This methodology builds directly on the framework introduced by Jorgenson, Slesnick, and Wilcoxen (1992), but generalizes it by including leisure time, as well as goods and services, in the measure of household welfare. We provide detailed results for 244 different types of households distinguished by demographic characteristics. In addition, we evaluate the overall impact of a cap-and-trade system, as represented in Energy Modeling Forum 22. While there is a wide range of outcomes for different demographic groups, the impact on economic welfare is regressive and generally negative but relatively small.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在提出一种评估气候政策分配效应的新方法。该方法直接建立在Jorgenson、Slesnick与Wilcoxen（1992）所提出的框架之上，但通过将闲暇时间与商品和服务一同纳入家庭福利的衡量中，对该框架进行了拓展。我们详细给出了按人口特征区分的244种不同类型家庭的结果。此外，我们评估了能源建模论坛第22项研究（EMF 22）所刻画的总量控制与交易体系的总体影响。尽管不同人口群体的结果差异很大，但其对经济福利的影响是累退的，总体上为负，但幅度相对较小。

title: Cap and Trade Climate Policy and US Economic Adjustments
Expecting the Unexpected: Macroeconomic Volatility and Climate Policy
abstract: To estimate the emissions reductions and costs of a climate policy, analysts usually compare a policy scenario with a baseline scenario of future economic conditions without the policy. Both scenarios require assumptions about the future course of numerous factors such as population growth, technical change, and non-climate policies like taxes. The results are only reliable to the extent that the future turns out to be reasonably close to the assumptions that went into the model. In this paper we examine the effects of unanticipated macroeconomic shocks to growth in developing countries or a global financial crisis on the performance of three climate policy regimes: a globally-harmonized carbon tax; a global cap and trade system; and the McKibbin-Wilcoxen hybrid. We use the G-Cubed dynamic general equilibrium model to explore how the shocks would affect emissions, prices, incomes, and wealth under each regime. We consider how the different climate policies tend to increase or decrease the shock's effect in the global economy and draw inferences about which policy approaches might better withstand such shocks. We find that a global cap and trade regime significantly changes the way growth shocks would otherwise be transmitted between regions while price-based systems such as a global carbon tax or a hybrid policy do not. Moreover, in the case of a financial meltdown, a price based system enables significant emissions reductions at low economic cost whereas a quantity target base system loses the opportunity for low cost emission reduction reductions because the target is fixed.
abstract_zh: 为估计气候政策的减排量与成本，分析人员通常会将政策情景与不含该政策的未来经济状况基准情景进行比较。两种情景都需要对诸多因素的未来走势做出假设，如人口增长、技术变革以及税收等非气候政策。只有当未来的实际发展与模型所依据的假设相当接近时，结果才是可靠的。在本文中，我们考察了发展中国家增长的意外宏观经济冲击或全球金融危机，对三种气候政策机制绩效的影响：全球统一的碳税、全球总量控制与交易体系，以及McKibbin-Wilcoxen混合方案。我们使用G-Cubed动态一般均衡模型，探讨这些冲击在每种机制下如何影响排放、价格、收入和财富。我们考虑了不同的气候政策如何增强或减弱冲击在全球经济中的效应，并由此推断哪些政策方式可能更好地经受住此类冲击。我们发现，全球总量控制制度显著改变了增长冲击在各地区间的传导方式，而全球碳税或混合政策等基于价格的体系则不然。此外，在金融危机的情形下，基于价格的体系能够以较低的经济成本实现显著的减排，而数量目标体系则会因目标固定而丧失低成本减排的机会。

title: The Economic and Environmental Effects of Border Tax Adjustments for Climate Policy
abstract: For the foreseeable future, climate change policy will be considerably more stringent in some countries than in others. Indeed, the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change explicitly states that developed countries must take meaningful action before any obligations are to be placed on developing countries. However, differences in climate policy will lead to differences in energy costs, and to concerns about competitive advantage. In high-cost countries, there will be political pressure to impose border adjustments, or “green tariffs”, on imports from countries with little or no climate policy and low energy costs. The adjustments would be based on the carbon emissions associated with production of each imported product, and would be intended to match the cost increase that would have occurred had the exporting country adopted a climate policy similar to that of the importing country. In this paper, we estimate how large such tariffs would be in practice, and then examine their economic and environmental effects using G-Cubed, a detailed multi-sector, multi-country model of the world economy. We find that the tariffs would be small on most traded goods, would reduce leakage of emissions reduction very modestly, and would do little to protect import-competing industries. We conclude that the benefits produced by border adjustments would be too small to justify their administrative complexity or their deleterious effects on international trade.
abstract_zh: 在可预见的未来，气候变化政策在一些国家将比在另一些国家严格得多。事实上，《联合国气候变化框架公约》明确规定，只有发达国家先采取有意义的行动，才能对发展中国家提出义务要求。然而，气候政策的差异将导致能源成本的差异，并引发对竞争优势的担忧。在高成本国家，将会出现政治压力，要求对来自气候政策较少或能源成本较低国家的进口商品征收边境调整税，即“绿色关税”。调整的依据是每一进口产品生产过程中的碳排放，其目的是抵消若出口国采取与进口国类似的气候政策本应发生的成本增加。在本文中，我们估计了此类关税在实践中的大小，并利用G-Cubed（一个详细的多部门、多国世界经济模型）考察了它们的经济与环境效应。我们发现，这些关税对大多数贸易商品而言都很小，只会非常有限地减少减排泄漏，对于保护与进口竞争的行业作用甚微。我们的结论是，边境调整带来的收益太小，不足以抵消其行政复杂性以及对国际贸易的有害影响。

title: Uncertainty and Climate Change Policy Design
China Can Grow and Still Help Prevent the Tragedy of the CO2 Commons
abstract: Under reasonable assumptions, China could achieve parity in living standard with Western Europe by 2100, and India by 2150. Climate change, however, may be a key obstacle preventing such a convergence. The business-as-usual (BAU) growth path of the world might increase concentration of atmospheric to unsafe levels and cause significant negative environmental feedback before China achieves parity in living standards with the OECD countries. We use a dynamic multi-country general equilibrium model (the G-Cubed Model) to project a realistic BAU trajectory of CO2 emissions, and we find it to be even above the CO2 emissions from the high-growth scenario estimated by the Energy Information Agency in 2007. This outcome is a reminder that it has been usual so far to underestimate the growth in China energy consumption. We compare the merits of the different market-based CO2 reduction mechanisms like a carbon tax, a cap-and-trade scheme, and the McKibbin-Wilcoxen Hybrid (MWH) approach. Unexpected developments cause the different CO2 reduction mechanisms to create very different costs. Both the international carbon tax and the MWH approach are more economically efficient responses to uncertainty than the cap-and-trade scheme of the Kyoto Protocol. We use the G-Cubed Model to study the economic outcomes under each CO2 reduction mechanism, and under the deployment of advanced green energy. The reduction of CO2 emissions would only delay, not stop, the increase in CO2 concentrations toward the “danger level”. As the only long-term solution is likely to be shifting to non-fossil emitting energy, it is important to combine a market-based CO2 reduction mechanism with an ambitious program to accelerate the development of green technology. Such a program would probably have a higher chance of success if some important parts of it were based on international collaboration. We conclude the paper with recommendations about the form of future international climate agreements and how China could be encouraged to participate.
abstract_zh: 在合理的假设下，到2100年中国的生活水平可能达到西欧的水平，到2150年印度则可能达到。然而，气候变化可能是阻碍这种趋同的关键障碍。在中国的生活水平赶上经合组织（OECD）国家之前，世界的一切照旧（BAU）增长路径可能使大气中的浓度上升至不安全水平，并引发显著的负向环境反馈。我们使用一个动态多国一般均衡模型（G-Cubed模型）来预测现实的一切照旧下的CO2排放轨迹，我们发现，其甚至高于2007年美国能源信息署（EIA）所估计的高增长情景下的CO2排放量。这一结果提醒我们，迄今为止人们通常低估了中国能源消费的增长。我们比较了不同基于市场的CO2减排机制的优劣，包括碳税、总量控制与交易，以及McKibbin-Wilcoxen混合（MWH）方法。意外的发展使得不同的CO2减排机制带来截然不同的成本。无论是国际碳税还是MWH方法，相较于《京都议定书》的总量控制与交易机制，都是对不确定性更具经济效率的应对方式。我们使用G-Cubed模型研究了每种CO2减排机制以及先进绿色能源部署下的经济结果。减少CO2排放只能推迟、而无法阻止CO2浓度向“危险水平”的上升。由于唯一的长期解决方案很可能是转向非化石能源，因此，将基于市场的CO2减排机制与加速绿色技术发展的雄心计划结合起来十分重要。如果其中一些重要部分建立在国际合作的基础上，此类计划成功的可能性可能更高。本文最后就未来国际气候协定的形式以及如何鼓励中国参与提出了建议。

title: US Labor Supply and Demand in the Long Run
A Credible Foundation for Long Term International Cooperation on Climate Change
abstract: T he first step toward meaningful progress on climate change is to be realistic about institutions – both about how existing institutions, such as national governments, can be brought to bear on the problem, and also about the prospects for creating powerful new international institutions. It is, in essence, a decision about whether it is more productive to bring existing tools, however imperfect, to bear on the problem or to design new and better tools at the international level. The latter course has attractions, but the risk is that the design process may go on indefinitely – with greenhouse gas emissions rising unchecked – without producing a viable new institution. Such has been the case over the last decade as attention has focused on designing the Kyoto Protocol, an elaborate new international institution without any real precedent that may do nothing to slow emissions. In this chapter we argue that a better alternative would be to tackle climate change with simpler policies that can be carried out by national governments immediately. As David Victor noted in chapter 4, that process is happening by default already. We discuss key characteristics needed in an effective approach to climate change and argue that prospects for creating a powerful international institution to control greenhouse gas emissions are dim at best. We then outline one policy, an internationally coordinated system of national policies based on a hybrid tradable permit mechanism, that can be implemented with minimal development of new international institutions.
abstract_zh: 在气候变化问题上取得实质进展，第一步是对制度保持现实态度——既要考虑现有制度（如各国政府）如何能够被用于应对这一问题，也要考虑创建强有力的新国际制度的前景。从本质上讲，这是一个决策问题：是更应当利用现有工具（尽管并不完美）来应对该问题，还是应当在国际层面设计更好的新工具。后一条路径有其吸引力，但风险在于，设计过程可能无限期拖延——温室气体排放因此不受约束地持续上升——而始终无法产生一个可行的新制度。过去十年便是如此：注意力集中于设计《京都议定书》，这是一个复杂且缺乏真正先例的新国际制度，而它可能对减缓排放毫无作用。本章认为，更好的替代方案是采取更为简单、各国政府可以立即实施的政策。正如David Victor在第4章中指出的，这一进程本已在默认情况下发生。我们讨论了应对气候变化的有效方法所需的关键特征，并认为，建立强有力的国际制度以控制温室气体排放的前景至多十分渺茫。随后，我们概述一种政策方案：基于混合型可交易许可机制的、由各国政策相互协调构成的国际体系，该方案可在极少新建国际制度的情况下实施。

title: The Role of Economics in Climate Change Policy
abstract: The most important characteristic of climate change as a policy problem is uncertainty. From climatology to economics, uncertainties are pervasive, large and difficult to resolve. However, the economic theory of environmental policy under uncertainty provides a clear guide to the design of an appropriate policy. An efficient and practical approach would be a hybrid that incorporates the best features of tradable permits and emissions taxes. Unfortunately, international negotiations have taken a different approach, focusing on rigid targets and timetables for emissions reductions. The result has been the Kyoto Protocol, an agreement with no real chance of reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
abstract_zh: 作为一个政策问题，气候变化最重要的特征是不确定性。从气候学到经济学，各类不确定性无处不在、规模巨大且难以消除。然而，关于不确定条件下环境政策的经济学理论为设计恰当的政策提供了清晰的指引。一种高效且切实可行的方法，是融合可交易许可与排放税各自最优特征的混合方案。遗憾的是，国际谈判采取了另一种思路，聚焦于刚性的减排目标和时间表。其结果便是《京都议定书》——一项实际上没有任何可能减少温室气体排放的协议。

abstract: This paper presents a new intertemporal general equilibrium model of the U. S. economy incorporating a detailed representation of U.S. tax structure. We employ the model to analyze the impact of fundamental tax reform on U.S. energy markets. More rapid economic growth would dominate energy conservation, leading to greater energy consumption and higher carbon emissions.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个新的跨期一般均衡模型，用以刻画美国经济，并对美国税制结构进行了详细的表述。我们运用该模型分析根本性税制改革对美国能源市场的影响。更快速的经济增长将抵消能源节约的效果，导致能源消费增加和碳排放上升。
